description: Sums five phasors, with a gain control on each, and offers that sum wrapped or folded back into the phasor range

params.text: Sets the gain of that row's phasor in the sum, 0 to 1, at 1 when new

inputs.text: One of the five phasors fed into the sum

outputs.text: The sum wrapped into 0-10V, so a sum past 10V starts again from 0V
The sum folded into 0-10V, so a sum past 10V turns around and comes back down

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
